name: Yongan Futures
summary: Yongan Futures Co.,Ltd., founded in 1992, was initially known as Zhejiang Yongan Futures Brokerage Co., Ltd. The company adopted its current name in September 2012. Headquartered in Hangzhou, China, this firm provides brokerage services for both commodity and financial futures, serving clients within China and internationally. Additionally, its offerings extend to wealth and asset management, the sale of funds, and futures investment consulting.
